source_note: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的
english_source_note: Nonexistence of a Limit for Sine on the Integers
callout_id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#2
statement_en: Prove the stronger statement that $\sin(n)$ is dense: namely, prove that the set formed by the sequence $x_n=\sin(n)$ is dense in the subspace $[-1,1]$.
key_techniques: continuous image of a dense set
callout_body: 证明$\sin(n)$是稠密的加强问题，证明$x_n=\sin(n)$这个序列形成的集合在子空间$[-1,1]$当中是稠密的。
